title: Sound Hunt
summary: Judy needs ambient tracks for a braindance and wants you to walk Jig-Jig Street at night as her walking microphone.
description: Judy needs ambient sound for a braindance, so she wants V to walk Jig-Jig Street at night as her walking microphone.

start.bringUp: Judy needs ambient sound for a braindance and wants you to walk Jig-Jig Street at night with her to record it. Bring up, in your own way, that you want V to come and walk the street with you.

north-arch.name: the north arch of Jig-Jig Street

JH3.invite.01.text: I need ambient tracks for a BD. You're my walking microphone.

g1.asks: What does this city sound like to you?
g1.know: The sounds Judy has recorded along Jig-Jig Street so far, and what she plans to use them for.

stages.label: Judy records the sounds of Jig-Jig Street at night
stages.objective: Walk Jig-Jig Street at night while Judy records the sounds
stages.know: You are walking Jig-Jig Street at night, and Judy is recording ambient sound for a braindance with a small device in her hand.
stages.wants: V to walk the street with her while she records.

recorded.memory: You walked Jig-Jig Street at night as Judy's walking microphone while she recorded the sounds of the city.

left.memory: You left Judy on Jig-Jig Street before she had finished recording the night.

variations.know: Rain on Jig-Jig Street, and Judy is delighted by every drop on the device.
A festival night on Jig-Jig Street, loud and full of people, and Judy wants the crowd on tape.
A power cut has gone through the street, and the quiet is the sound Judy wants.
